default_requirement.input_scope: Cold frontend canvas interactions and frame-visible behavior with direct MouseCtl stubs; full legal input reachability and exclusions remain unreviewed.

requirements.input_scope: Cold initialized production frontend: canvas/value/selection edits, frame-visible effects, netlist IDs/order, banks/replies, held buttons and all SW frontend modes. Physical PS2/CDC excluded only through explicit stub exclusions; reachability review incomplete.

requirements.input_scope: Frame request capture, all editing modes/rotations/edges, held/drag inputs, command-ready and read-response stalls, blocked placements and cancellation; legal input reachability review incomplete.

requirements.input_scope: Synchronous frame_start_pulse capture: reset dominance, idle stability, isolated/consecutive pulses, all button combinations, unsigned mouse coordinates and signed grid offsets. Physical asynchronous PS2/CDC is not qualified.
requirements.scope_review_note: Read complete InteractionFrameCapture.v: no handshake, buffering or drop policy exists in this module; snapshot_valid follows frame_start_pulse unless reset. Coverage evidence does not prove CDC.

requirements.input_scope: Accepted command bursts, two-cell placement and three-write rotation, occupied/edge partners, ready/read stalls, reset and atomic publication; reachability review incomplete.

requirements.input_scope: Combinational horizontal left-only / vertical right-only commands, simultaneous or middle suppression, canvas/grid bounds and signed pan offsets; occupied-cell policy and held/drag sequencing belong to controller/integration.
requirements.scope_review_note: Read complete WireDrawMode.v: module has no state/clock or occupied-cell input. Input-domain review does not establish integrated trajectory coverage.

requirements.input_scope: FIFO reset/clear, one-cycle delayed completions, pre-update length, empty/full rejection, simultaneous add/pop, data truncation and reset-free lifetime across non-power-of-two DEPTH=1152 pointer wraps.
requirements.scope_review_note: Read complete FloodQueueStore.v and integrated QUEUE_DEPTH=GRID_WIDTH*GRID_HEIGHT*4: pointers increment at PTR_WIDTH rather than explicit modulo DEPTH; reset-free lifetime and FIFO order remain unqualified. No unreachable-counter exclusion is authorized.
